# VaRoom

> VaRoom is a Kenyan marketplace for booking spaces: stays, workspaces and venues. Hosts list GPS-verified spaces; guests search, compare and book them, and chat with hosts.

- Every listing has a verified location.
- Guests book spaces and message hosts in VaRoom; hosts manage their listings and bookings.
- Prices are in Kenyan shillings (KSh).

## Pages

- [Home](https://varoom.co.ke/): What VaRoom offers guests and hosts, with featured spaces and reviews.
- [Marketplace](https://varoom.co.ke/marketplace): Browse and search the spaces listed on VaRoom.
- [Pricing](https://varoom.co.ke/pricing): Plans for hosts who list spaces.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://varoom.co.ke/terms): The terms for using VaRoom.
- [Privacy Policy](https://varoom.co.ke/privacy): How VaRoom collects and uses personal data.
